intent: Make the first playable minutes feel like a live construction shift rather than an exposition/tutorial sequence, without changing branch topology or save-state rules.
presentation_rules: Use concrete time, sound, movement and competing work priorities before explaining safety concepts.
Every choice should expose what the player gains and what becomes temporarily unattended.
Character voices should reveal role pressure instead of reciting a safety answer.
Cinematic stamps should tell the player why the next scene matters without labeling a choice correct or incorrect.
